notes: Credit, and a start and finish read from the map's own logic (chk-maps run 64). The 32 spawns stand in the start room round the `start` destination (every way back to the beginning aims there); the start is a box round it. Levels lvl1..lvl6 and the finale follow (finale_01..04), each block behind the anti-standing trap below. Past finale_04 a trigger in the last room closes door5 and shows the `credit` hud hint; that trigger is the finish. That room also has five door-sized teleports back to start, lvl2, lvl3, lvl6 and the finale: a level select after the finish, imported as pits that keep the run. The trigger_pushes behind `filter_activator_boost` (renamed by the floor under them) import as plain pushes. Not published.

zones.note: the start room, round the `start` destination beside the spawns; 192 units down because the room's floor (about 520) is 88 under the spawns' origins
the trigger in the last room past finale_04 that closes door5 and shows the credit hud hint

conditional_teleports.note: the anti-standing blocks: a block's trigger renames the player `activator` 0.09 s after landing and `default` 0.01 s later, and these teleports fire only for that name
